topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I just got home, and there on my doorstep was a package. Of course, it's not for me. It's for the previous tenant. This is the third time this month! I can't believe how irresponsible these people are. It's like they don't even check the address. I have better things to do than play post office for someone else. Now I have to figure out what to do with this. I seriously doubt they'll even notice it's missing, but I guess I'll have to try to get it to them somehow. Just what I needed today.
